visual_objective.visual_objective: 髪の状態を理解してから整え方を選ぶ安心感を、落ち着いた大人向け美容表現として可視化する。
visual_objective.intended_first_impression: 落ち着き・信頼・上品さ・相談しやすさ

evidence_or_reasoning: Creative Concept requires calm consultation rather than trend-first energy.
Existing brand color evidence is insufficient, therefore category-safe neutral is combined with a calm trust-oriented accent direction.
Color must remain secondary to hair/result and consultation imagery.

typography_direction.emphasis_style: restrained serif emphasis or medium-weight sans
legibility_constraints: no decorative font for body copy

usage_constraints: official public image usage is NOT_CONFIRMED; final commercial production needs approved/licensed/generated alternatives

layout_density_direction.hero_structure_direction: large beauty visual plus concise problem/benefit message
layout_density_direction.full_bleed_usage_direction: use for future-state or salon proof imagery
layout_density_direction.section_variation_direction: alternate concern, visual aspiration, philosophy, evidence, experience, diagnosis

cta_treatment_direction.sticky_cta_behavior_direction: compact persistent mobile CTA after hero; must not cover key visual/text content
cta_treatment_direction.button_tone: deep green / high contrast / rounded but not oversized

visual_proof_contract.minimum_proof_role: Customer must be able to imagine a more manageable, naturally polished future state and understand the consultation-led experience.
evidence_limitations: commercial reuse rights for current public images not confirmed

genericness_check.notes: Direction remains specific only if future-state visuals and copy stay tied to condition-aware consultation; generic green salon styling alone would be insufficient.
